description: Teachers will receive secure digital identities and access to AI-powered tools, including Notebook and Gemini, for teaching, lesson planning and administrative work.
body_lead: AI push in Assam govt schools, 1 lakh teachers to get training by May 2027 Teachers will receive secure digital identities and access to AI-powered tools, including Notebook and Gemini, for teaching, lesson planning and administrative work. GUWAHATI, Sept 5: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is set to enter government school classrooms in Assam on a major scale, with nearly one lakh teachers scheduled to receive AI training by May 2027.
